name: Cupid Breweries and Distilleries Limited
about: Cupid Breweries and Distilleries Limited trades raw materials and intermediary products for the alcoholic beverages (alcobev) industry in India. It engages in the manufacture and sale of beer, Indian Made Liquor (IML), craft beer, microbrewery operation, Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL), and craft spirits. The company was formerly known as Cupid Trades and Finance Limited and changed its name to Cupid Breweries and Distilleries Limited in July 2024. Cupid Breweries and Distilleries Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
